title: Solar Access Path Decision
description: Decision payload produced by AccessPathOptimizer. Records which access path was selected, why, and the fallback chain. Decision trace is written to Evidence Ledger as kind=access_path_decision. Attempt Ledger is NOT the audit source for access decisions.

task_ref.description: Stable task id from optimizer compiler task envelope.

capsule_ref.description: Capsule id from Capsule Registry, including access_contract and mode.supports.

decision.description: Selected access path. Fallback priority is terminal-first: terminal_direct_api > terminal_explore_api > mcp_adapter > hybrid_min_browser > browser_fallback.

rationale.description: Human-readable decision reason using input signals. Must reference which signals drove the decision.

fallback_chain.description: Ordered fallback list. Never promotes MCP/browser above terminal when terminal is viable.

input_signals.description: Signals used to make the decision. All values come from task envelope, capsule registry, platform profile, or policy — no hardcoded data.

api_completeness.description: Float 0..1, derived from declared API coverage probe.

mcp_tool_schema_coverage.description: Float 0..1, MCP adapter field coverage only.

need_rendered_state.description: True only when rendered UI state is required.

session_bound_workflow.description: True when auth/session cookie workflow cannot be represented by API.

arbitrary_payload_discovery.description: True when unknown fields or payload discovery is required.

browser_as_min_fallback.description: Must be true before browser fallback can be selected (policy gate).

evidence_refs.description: Evidence Ledger references for probes and policy checks.

reason_code.description: Machine-readable denial reason. e.g. policy_forbidden, capsule_forbidden, insufficient_api_coverage.

policy_denials.description: Any rejected paths and reason codes.
